subject.title: Feature request: Self-hosting without a Cloudflare dependency

question: Should ClawRouter commit to maintaining a non-Cloudflare runtime with equivalent security, consistency, migration, and operational guarantees?
rationale: Current main integrates several Cloudflare services, while repository policy favors a provider-neutral data plane; choosing whether portability becomes a supported product contract requires maintainer intent.

options.title: Stay Cloudflare-native
options.body: Keep one authoritative deployment model and document that non-Cloudflare self-hosting is not currently supported.

options.title: Design portable contracts
options.body: Approve an architecture phase for provider-neutral runtime interfaces and conformance tests before selecting an alternative stack.

options.title: Support one local stack
options.body: Commit to a maintained Docker deployment with explicit replacements for authority, persistence, queues, and identity.

recommendation.title: Stay Cloudflare-native
recommendation.body: Keep one authoritative deployment model and document that non-Cloudflare self-hosting is not currently supported.

likelyOwner.reason: The initial gateway history most directly connects this person to the runtime architecture whose permanent support boundary is in question.
